Messages.Author: Madman
Messages.Body:
Hey, folks, I just got the Origins pre-reg booklet and I can find only two
V:tES events. What's going on here?? There were at least 3, maybe 4, last
year. And there's no draft or sealed event either, just a standard
tournament
Friday and another Saturday.

This is certainly a discouraging note! I had understood that this game was
undergoing a renaissance!! The draft and the sealed attract the occasional
player and was, for example, the only types of tournaments I would play in
for
several years.

If no one has anything planned, I would be happy to host a draft event on
Thursday.

Madman the discouraged

Messages.Author: Kevin M.
Messages.Body:
"Madman" <Madma...@MailAndNews.com> wrote in message
news:3AEF...@MailAndNews.com...

> Hey, folks, I just got the Origins pre-reg booklet and I can find only
two
> V:tES events. What's going on here?? There were at least 3, maybe 4,
last
> year. And there's no draft or sealed event either, just a standard
> tournament
> Friday and another Saturday.

Since I'm the one running the events, I guess I should answer. :)

The Origins tournament that begins at 2pm on Friday is a normal,
standard, sanctioned event.

The Origins tournament that begins at 2pm on Saturday is the regional
qualifier for the North American Championship, which will be hosted at
GenCon 2001.

> This is certainly a discouraging note! I had understood that this game
was
> undergoing a renaissance!! The draft and the sealed attract the
occasional
> player and was, for example, the only types of tournaments I would play
in
> for several years.
>
> If no one has anything planned, I would be happy to host a draft event
on
> Thursday.

You may not be able to, even if you want to.

In the past, Origins has frowned on people running events without
submitting them as an official Origins event, so that Origins can get
their "cut". I can certainly ask White Wolf (i.e. LSJ) to give me
permission to run a draft event on Thursday as an official Origins event.
What they would provide as product to draft with, however, I cannot say.

>
> Madman the discouraged

Don't be discouraged. I'll try to get a draft event in there on Thursday
for you. If I do, I'll post it here for everyone so that they know the
time.

Kevin J. Mergen, Prince of Madison, WI

Messages.Author: Madman
Messages.Body:
Kevin:

Thanks for the response (and sorry for all multiple postings - my connection
was bouncing that night).

Regarding unsanctioned events, for years at Origins several Magic Old-timers
and I have been scheduling private events up on the walkway. However, if we
wanted to ensure that the casual or novice player had an opportunity to
play,
we should see about getting something official (read: in the onsite book).
It
just might be too late for that however.

And, given the non-response to my posting, perhaps there's no demand for
events other than the Friday and Saturday constructed. Dunno.

Madman
